issue_request: FHIR-18508 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR Infrastructure change request for OperationOutcome asking whether HTTP header names and URL/body query parameter names could collide. The accepted resolution was to add an unmodified search-parameter example, clarify that the narrative describes FHIRPath values in issue.expression rather than deprecated issue.location, and add a note that the spec's uppercase-header/lowercase-parameter convention avoids collisions.

Current blame still attributes those requested lines to that issue-tagged commit.
